_comment: EMS product IDs and form labels. Keys starting with _ are comments. IS_TEST_MODE in .env selects the test or production IDs.

next-serial-number-customer-id._comment: The customer ID used for the next serial number. Stored in their ref ID as JSON object. e.g., {"NextSerial": "06003"}

lease-expiry-range._comment: Inclusive calendar months after the entitlement start date.

product-options._comment: The form enforces at least one of these.

optional-products._comment: Any or none of these can be selected.

version._comment: Only one can be selected. An option with an empty product ID is the default and adds no product.

lease._comment: Selecting this shows the lease expiry date and writes the base product Expiry Date segment.
